notes.title: Stability and Performance Update (10/14)
notes.content:
Hello! This is the development team for Five Hearts Under One Roof!

First, we want to extend our gratitude to everyone who patiently waited for the full release of Five Hearts Under One Roof on October 3rd. We are dedicated to providing the best possible experience for all players and will continue to closely monitor and address any issues that arise as quickly as we can.

[10/14 Update Patch Notes]


 Fixed the issue of the main character’s voice not turning off in some episodes.


 Added more bans for ranking system cheaters.

[10/08 Update Patch Notes]


 Reordered some episodes.


 Fixed interactions between scene transitions and the video interface.


 Fixed a bug in chat-to-video transitions.


 Improved translation accuracy.


 Fixed display issues with Traditional Chinese characters.


 Fixed discrepancies in unlocking achievements and album videos.

[10/04 Update Patch Notes]


 Fixed missing Chinese translations.


 Corrected option mislabels.


 Banned users for abnormal voting.


 Fixed abnormal achievement clears.

[10/03 Update Patch Notes]


 Fixed an issue where text would not display correctly during the initial game launch.


We deeply appreciate the continued support from all of our STEAM players. Rest assured, we are working our best to resolve any bugs and ensure a smoother gameplay experience moving forward.

Thank you from the entire Five Hearts Under One Roof development team.

notes.title: DEMO Update Announcement (Including Visual Quality Enhancements)
notes.content:
Greetings from the Five Hearts Under One Roof development team!

We are incredibly grateful for the overwhelming response to the DEMO version of Five Hearts Under One Roof, which launched on September 3rd. The number of players has far exceeded our expectations, and we sincerely thank you for your support.

We’ve been carefully reviewing all the ✨valuable feedback✨ provided by players and are actively working to address these issues as a priority. We look forward to receiving more of your feedback 💌.

* Don’t forget to join the ongoing DEMO event to win a full version Steam key!
👉Click here for DEMO event details

[Five Hearts Under One Roof DEMO 09.13 Update Notes]


 Added an option to toggle the male protagonist's voice ON/OFF in-game


 Adjusted the spacing in album cutscene screens


 Modified certain system effects, including chatting and affection calculation


 Updated some resource images, such as album and chapter progress rewards

[Five Hearts Under One Roof DEMO 09.06 Update Notes]

 Fixed missing subtitles after replaying the video twice in Yuman's house exploration.


 Restricted access to Sausage Guy’s hidden route in certain scenarios for better story immersion.

[Five Hearts Under One Roof DEMO 09.05 Update Notes]


 Resolved an issue causing in-game video quality degradation


 Fixed delays between voice lines and subtitles


 Improved translation accuracy for English and Chinese subtitles


 Made enhancements to visual effects and controller compatibility

The Five Hearts Under One Roof Development Team
